title: Gracie Abrams Irving Plaza Concert in NYC: Listen on SiriusXM
summary: Hear Gracie perform songs from “Daughter from Hell” and fan favorites during her intimate Irving Plaza concert.
body_markdown:
[Gracie Abrams](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/gracie-abrams) performed an intimate concert at Irving Plaza in New York City on October 24 as part of the[SiriusXM Small Stage Series](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/small-stage-series) — and fans can hear the special performance on SiriusXM.


[Small Stage Series: Gracie Abrams Exclusive concert at Irving Plaza Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogGracieAbramsSSS-Hits1)


The GRAMMY-nominated singer-songwriter’s performance, presented by Hershey’s, featured music from her latest album,[Daughter from Hell](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/gracie-abrams-daughter-from-hell) , alongside fan favorites.


- **Related:[Listen to Ella Langley’s Small Stage Series Show in Denver](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ella-langley-denver-concert)**


### How to Listen to Gracie Abrams’ Small Stage Series Concert


SiriusXM subscribers can hear the full performance on[SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-hits-1) at the following times:


- Friday, October 30 at 9pm ET
- Saturday, October 31 at 3pm ET
- Sunday, November 1 at 7pm ET


The concert will also be available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogGracieAbramsSSS-Hits1) .


Select songs from the performance will also air on[The Pulse](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-pulse) ,[Unwell Music](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/unwell-music) , and[The Coffee House](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-coffee-house) .


### About SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series


SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series brings major artists to intimate venues for exclusive performances. Previous artists have included Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, Alicia Keys, Lainey Wilson, Kenny Chesney, and more.
